Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Norris Bradbury directed the Los Alamos project that developed the first atomic bomb, conflating postwar leadership with the wartime period. This misinterpreted the historical timeline, as J. Robert Oppenheimer was the Los Alamos Laboratory director during the development and Trinity test (1942–1945).
